title: Release Manifest Binding
intent: Bind release decisions to exact artifact, test, evidence, and policy digests.
problem: Without release signature covers artifact, evidence, test and policy digests, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the release manifest binding contract.
context: This pattern addresses a deployable bundle needs independent certification; its concrete control is release signature covers artifact, evidence, test and policy digests.
forces: Correctness requires that any released byte change invalidates certification
Operational pressure can cause: tests run against a different build
solution: Implement release signature covers artifact, evidence, test and policy digests. Verify the anchored symbol `CertificationError` with `test_actual_api_vectors_produce_signed_canonical_release_manifest` before reuse.
invariants: any released byte change invalidates certification
release identity includes the complete tested manifest
failure_modes: tests run against a different build
mutable evidence URLs replace content hashes
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `tests run against a different build` and fails closed if the release manifest binding evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For release manifest binding, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to release signature covers artifact, evidence, test and policy digests.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: a deployable bundle needs independent certification
Do not apply when: an exploratory local build will not be distributed
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: a deployable bundle needs independent certification
not_when: an exploratory local build will not be distributed
